meta.title: Igor Iansen — Portfolio
meta.description: Portfolio of Igor Iansen, a Multiplatform Software Development student focused on full-stack development.
sobre.texto.1: I'm a Multiplatform Software Development student and an early-career full-stack developer. I like following an idea from end to end, from the interface to the API and database.
sobre.texto.2: My experience comes from academic and personal projects as well as hackathons. I mainly work with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Express and PostgreSQL, always trying to understand the decisions behind the code.
sobre.texto.3: I learn best by building. I enjoy tracking down bugs, breaking problems into smaller parts and sharing knowledge with the people around me. I'm now looking for my first professional opportunity in the field.
info.formacao.texto: I'm in the second semester of Multiplatform Software Development at Fatec Jacareí. It's where I work across different stages of a product and build projects as part of a team.
info.foco.texto: I want to explore cybersecurity and artificial intelligence gradually, bringing what I learn into projects I can test in practice.
info.hobbies.texto: I play drums, follow anime and enjoy competitive games. I'm also an altar server at my local parish and really enjoy cars and sport motorcycles.
